text:
Some context for readers:
The Nativ process is required only of couples where the foreign side is from a former USSR country.
This requirement is pesudo-legal and has been contested by האגודה הישראלית לזוגות בינלאומיים aic.org.il for years, but with limited success cancelling it so far. 
You can read more about what we did and our claims on the AIC website.

To your questions, I would only attach documents that you already have for the partner visa process and nothing else.
